materials.article:
Getting to Know Each Other

Welcome to your first session with members from your support group.

Here, you will find content to prepare yourself for your sessions every week.

Your group will be a very important source of support for you throughout your journey. Here you will get together with other people, who like you, are on their way to better health and inner peace. And just like you, they are dealing with similar questions and challenges.

It is wonderful to talk with others, give each other mutual support and learn from one another. And even though this is so easy, we don't actually take the time to really connect with ourselves or others. It takes courage, to open up and let others in. Because the moment we do, we also feel more vulnerable. Exactly for this reason, you and you alone decide what you want to share with your group. If all members treat each other mindfully and with respect, this will provide ample opportunity to have new experiences and make some progress. Just listening and the fact that your own emotions and feelings are recognized and you are allowed to express them, already has a healing effect.

So, it's nothing too complicated, just listen with an open heart and learn to give your own thoughts and feelings a room in which they are allowed to just be.

The Video Session

The first session is just about getting to know one another a little, as you will be doing a part of this journey together. If at the end of the session there is still a little time left over, you can discuss the topic of "Awareness".

The structure to the session will always be similar. When everyone has logged in, you will first watch a Video of our LeanOnMe Psychologist. She will give you a bit of input and then you will have a lot of time and space for your discussions.

And don't worry, everything doesn't always have to be difficult, it can be simple. Joy, humor and laughter are definitely allowed. Are you curious yet?

Key Points:

  • Getting to know each other
  • What does the word "mindfulness" mean to you?

topic: Getting to know each other. What is your motivation to lose weight?

groupSessionProgramEvents.text: Hello everyone, not all members have logged in. We will start when everyone is here (latest after 3 minutes).
Here, you will find instructions on what to do or what’s coming up next.
At the top there is a timer, which will tell you how much time is left in the session.
We will start with a short introductory video.
For the duration of the video, your microphone will be muted. The video lasts about 3 minutes. Have fun!
Someone may start by describing their perfect day.
The following questions can help you keep the conversation going like: What is the weather like on your perfect day?
How do you feel? Are you with others or alone? What do you eat? What is important to you in life?
If everyone has presented their perfect day, share your thoughts on the topic “Mindfulness”. What do you think of when you hear the word “mindfulness”
What are the biggest stressors in your day-to-day life?
How can you reduce these stressors? What helps you to relax after a stressful day?
You now have five minutes left till the session ends. Use this as an opportunity to say goodbye to each other.
Thank you for participating! Have a lovely week!
